title: AgentCapabilityCard
description: The PUBLIC, stable description of ONE governed CapabilityTask the Teleon Agent Capability Gateway offers to agent consumers — what `describe` returns. It is a contract an agent can plan against: the purpose, the input/output contracts, the allowed_use / forbidden_use envelope, the expected_cost + expected_latency it can budget for, the freshness_policy on any served facts, and the governance switches deterministic_first (the token-saving ladder runs deterministic/cache/API BEFORE any LLM), llm_fallback_allowed (whether a frontier LLM may be reached at all, and only when policy allows), and receipt_required (whether a run MUST emit an AgentCapabilityReceipt). Law: agents ASK, Teleon EXECUTES, Baltor governs truth — a capability proposes/serves governed evidence, never self-asserted LLM truth.

capability_id.description: stable id of the capability (e.g. cfpb.deadline.verify, utility.hash, json.schema.validate)

purpose.description: the declared, bounded purpose of this capability — what repeatable workflow it solves so the agent does not burn tokens re-solving it

input_contract.description: the shape/contract of accepted input (a schema-ref or inline shape); what the agent must send

output_contract.description: the shape/contract of the returned output; what the agent can rely on receiving

allowed_use.description: the uses this capability's output is licensed/governed for (carried forward onto every result and receipt)

forbidden_use.description: uses explicitly disallowed (e.g. 'treat as legal advice', 'auto-promote to served truth')

expected_cost.description: expected cost envelope the agent can budget against (e.g. {unit: 'usd', typical, max, metric: 'per_successful_run'})

freshness_policy.description: freshness/recency guarantees on any served facts (e.g. {max_age: '24h', cdc: true, revocation_handled: true}); volatile public facts without CDC/revocation handling are not served

policy_notes.description: human-readable governance notes (review requirements, jurisdiction, signer accountability)

deterministic_first.description: ALWAYS true — the token-saving ladder runs cached-verified -> deterministic parser -> direct API -> local calc BEFORE any LLM; deterministic-first is a gateway invariant, not a per-capability toggle

llm_fallback_allowed.description: whether a frontier-LLM step is permitted for this capability at all, and only after the deterministic ladder is exhausted and policy allows; LLM output is still never served truth

receipt_required.description: when true, a run of this capability MUST emit an AgentCapabilityReceipt or be treated as unavailable
